name: intern-attendance
description: Intern Attendance Fullstack System (Ionic React + NestJS Fastify Node)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix ClientApp
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const p of ['public', 'server/public', 'server/dist', 'ClientApp/dist', 'ClientApp/dev-dist']) { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } })"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && node scripts/copy-client.mjs
scripts.ship: node scripts/publish-production-branch.mjs && git push -f origin production
